title: A father in Gaza searches for his family's bones in the rubble of their home
description:
(11 Feb 2026) 
RESTRICTION SUMMARY:

ASSOCIATED PRESS
Gaza City, Gaza Strip – 24 January 2026 
1. Mahmoud Hammad shaking sand in large sieve, looking for bones of his wife and children who were killed in Israeli airstrike 
2. Hammad pulling piece of bone from the sand and setting it aside
3. Various of Hammad and his relative digging and searching
4. Various of Hammad shaking sand in large sieve, looking for bones
5. SOUNDBITE (Arabic) Mahmoud Hammad, lost his family in Israeli airstrike:
”My wife and all my children, my brother, his wife, and their children were martyred. I am psychologically exhausted. I am not saddened by their fate, but because I was unable to bury them, to honor them. Therefore, I insisted on searching for them, honoring them, and burying them in Muslim cemeteries.”
6. Various of bag containing bones that Hammad found under rubble
7. SOUNDBITE (Arabic) Mahmoud Hammad, lost his family in Israeli airstrike:
"After approaching organizations (for help in searching for bodies under the rubble), I was not defeated. I saw the reality: there were no bulldozers, and the crossings were only open for certain people. So, I was forced to resort to simple tools: a digger, a hammer, and a sieve. I began breaking down the roofs, one after another, and reducing the stones to this size.”
8. Various of Hammad shaking sand in large sieve, looking for bones
9. SOUNDBITE (Arabic) Mahmoud Hammad, lost his family in Israeli airstrike:
"Thank God, two days ago I found the jawbone of one of my sons. This is a sign that I will reach the rest of my children, God willing. But I will not find them all. I only found 1.8 kilograms of bones belonging to my wife and daughter. After identifying the area where my wife was, I found two shoulder bones. I contacted a doctor on WhatsApp and asked him, 'Doctor, whose bones are these?' He said they were a baby, only a day or two old. I knew my wife was in her tenth month of pregnancy, so I knew she was here.”
10. Various of Hammad and others digging under rubble 

ASSOCIATED PRESS
Gaza City, Gaza Strip – 8 February 2026 
11. Various of bulldozer removing rubble looking for remains of people who were killed in Israeli airstrike 
12. Various of people standing near bags containing remains of killed people 
13. Bulldozer removing rubble
14. People gathering near bags containing remains of killed people

ASSOCIATED PRESS
Gaza City, Gaza Strip – 7 February 2026 
15. SOUNDBITE (Arabic) Ramzi Salim, lost his family in Israeli airstrike: 
“After two years and two and a half months, after numerous appeals at all levels, the organizations finally helped us. They extinguished the fire in our hearts and helped us recover the bodies of our children. There were more than 120 martyrs here. 54 martyrs are still under the rubble today.”
16. Women looking at bulldozer removing rubble 
17. People gathering near rubble 
18. Civil defense carrying bag containing remains of killed people
19. Skulls among rubble 
20. Civil defense taking bones out of rubble
21. Various of Ramzi Salim sitting near bags containing remains of his killed relatives and crying 

ASSOCIATED PRESS
Gaza City, Gaza Strip – 8 February 2026 
22. SOUNDBITE (Arabic) Rafeeq Salim, lost his family in Israeli strikes:
23. Various of of Ramzi Salim and other people carrying bags containing remains of their killed relatives out of rubble and placing on the ground 
24. SOUNDBITE (Arabic) Rafeeq Salim, lost his family in Israeli strikes:
25. Various of people gathering near containing remains of killed people on the ground near destroyed building
